description: (Na)₂NaScCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaScCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaScCl₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.69 Å. Sc is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form ScCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sc-Cl bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Sc atom.
